description: The last lit thing on Meltwater Row before the road gives up. A blade sign four storeys tall stands off the corner in stacked letters, R E E L, and about a third of the bulbs in it are out in a pattern that has not changed in years. Under it a canopy runs out over the pavement on two chained rods, its underside a grid of little lamps, and under that a run of glazed doors with brass push-plates worn down to the white metal. The letter board beside the doors reads NOW SHOWING · THE METER READER · 8PM ONLY, and it has read that for long enough that the board has faded around the letters.
name: Reel Estate
